Brand.name: Facility Hub
Brand.tagline: Your direct line to Facility Operations, for maintenance and cleaning across Omantel buildings.

Home.title: Your Workplace, Our Priority.
Home.description: Noticed something that needs maintenance or cleaning? Let us know. Omantel Facility Hub connects you directly with Facility Operations, helping us respond promptly and maintain a safe, clean, and comfortable workplace.
Home.servicesSubtitle: Choose a service and we'll guide you step by step. It takes about a minute.
Home.maintenanceText: Let us know when something in the building needs maintenance attention.
Home.cleaningText: Help us keep our shared spaces clean, comfortable, and welcoming.
Home.quickMyText: Follow your reports as they progress
Home.quickQrText: Start a report from the code on site
Home.quickMapText: Find a place and report from the map
Home.quickGuideText: What we cover and what to expect
Home.recentEmpty: You haven't shared any reports yet. Whenever you notice something, we're here to help.
Home.signInPrompt: Sign in to see your requests and follow their progress.
Home.buildingTitle: Connecting you with the team that cares for our building
Home.buildingText: Facility Operations looks after our building every day through regular inspections, maintenance follow-ups and cleaning supervision. Facility Hub gives you a clear, convenient channel to share what you notice, so it reaches the right team quickly and can be resolved on time.
Home.step1Text: Choose maintenance or cleaning, then the floor and area, or scan the QR code on site.
Home.step2Text: Your report, location and photos go straight to Facility Operations for coordination.
Home.step3Text: Get a reference number, e-mail updates, and confirm once everything is as it should be.
Home.safetyTitle: In an emergency, please call first
Home.safetyText: Smoke, exposed wiring, water near electricity, blocked exits or someone trapped in a lift: contact building security or emergency services immediately through the verified channels in your building.
Home.qrHint: Point your camera at the Facility Hub code on site.
Home.qrUnsupported: This browser can't scan codes here. Open your phone's camera app and point it at the code instead.
Home.qrDenied: Camera access was blocked. Allow the camera, or use your phone's camera app.
Home.qrInvalid: This isn't a Facility Hub location code.
Home.subtitle: Together, We Make Every Space Better.
Home.valuesTitle: Together, we keep our workplace at its best.
Home.value2: Your feedback helps us respond faster.
Home.value3: Thank you for letting us know.

Footer.about: A direct communication bridge between Omantel employees and Facility Operations for maintenance and cleaning. Together, we keep our workplace at its best.
Footer.itNote: IT, computer, network and audio-visual issues are handled by IT support, not Facility Hub.

PriorityHelp.LOW: Cosmetic or can wait a few days
PriorityHelp.MEDIUM: Affects comfort or work, not urgent
PriorityHelp.HIGH: Disrupts work or may cause damage
PriorityHelp.EMERGENCY: Immediate risk to people or the building

Fields.meetingRoomPh: As shown on the door sign

Wizard.title: New request
Wizard.serviceHelp: We're here to help. Choose the service that fits what you noticed. Computers, network, software and audio-visual equipment are handled by IT support.
Wizard.locationHelp: Choose the floor and area. You can add exact details below to help the team find it quickly.
Wizard.fromQr: Location filled in from the QR code. You can change it.
Wizard.fromMap: Location chosen on the building map. You can change it.
Wizard.otherLocationPh: Building, floor and the nearest landmark
Wizard.problemHelp: Options are based on the area you chose.
Wizard.descriptionPh: What you noticed, since when, and anything that would help the team before arriving.
Wizard.descriptionHint: Example: "Two ceiling lights flicker near column C-14, worse in the evening."
Wizard.photosHelp: Up to {max} photos, {size} MB each (JPG, PNG or WebP). A photo helps the team arrive prepared. Your feedback helps us respond faster.
Wizard.reviewHelp: Check the details below. Once you send it, you'll receive a reference number to follow your request.
Wizard.successTitle: Thank You for Letting Us Know!
Wizard.successText: Your report has been successfully received by Facility Operations. Thank you for helping us maintain a safe, clean, and comfortable workplace.
Wizard.chooseIssue: Choose a problem, or describe it under "Something else".
Wizard.noAreas: No areas are configured for this floor yet. Choose "Other" or another floor.
Wizard.noIssues: No predefined problems for this area. Describe it under "Something else".
Wizard.searchNoResults: No matching locations. Choose the floor below, or Other.
Wizard.chooseWing: Choose a wing, or “I'm not sure”.
Wizard.specificLocationHelp: Optional. Pick it from the list if you see it.
Wizard.locationDescriptionPh: Anything that helps the team find the exact spot
Wizard.locationDescriptionRequired: Please describe where it is (at least 5 characters).
Wizard.provisionalNote: Areas on this floor are being confirmed with the official building map. If you can't find your location, choose Other and describe it.

Safety.title: This may be an emergency
Safety.text: If there is smoke, a burning smell, exposed wiring, water near electrical equipment, a blocked emergency exit or someone trapped in an elevator, contact building security or emergency services immediately through your building's verified channels. Do not rely on this online request.
Safety.noContact: Use the emergency numbers posted in your building.
Safety.acknowledge: I've contacted security / it's not an emergency. Continue

config.locationsHelp: Building → Floor → Wing → Area → Specific location. Employees only see active, non-archived items. Mark anything not yet checked against the official building map as provisional.
config.categoriesHelp: Categories and the problems employees can pick. Area types and floors decide where each problem is offered.
config.teamsHelp: Contractors can only receive requests after their scope is confirmed.
config.members: {count, plural, =0 {No members} one {# member} other {# members}}
config.routingHelp: The first active rule that matches a request (top to bottom) suggests its team. With auto-assign, the request is assigned on submission.
config.slaHelp: Targets per priority. Leave empty for no target. Values marked "Sample" are development placeholders, not approved commitments.
config.emergencyHelp: Shown in the safety warning. Leave empty until Facility Operations provides a verified number.
config.emailsHelp: Variables: {vars}. E-mails are queued and sent in the background.
config.mapsHelp: Upload an approved floor plan (PNG, JPG, WebP or SVG), place markers and draw zones, then publish. Unpublished maps are never shown to employees.
config.zoneHint: Click to add corners, then Finish zone.
config.pointHint: Click on the plan to place a marker.
config.qrHelp: Each code opens the request form with the location filled in. Codes contain only a random token.
config.regenerateConfirm: Old printed codes for this area will stop working. Continue?
config.usersHelp: Users are created automatically on first Microsoft sign-in. Assign roles here. Contractors only see requests for their team.
config.areaLibraryHelp: Reusable area types for every floor and building. A floor shows only the areas assigned to it.
config.specificHelp: Rooms, offices, meeting rooms, parking sections, elevators, entrances, landmarks and columns. Leave the area empty for floor-wide items such as elevators and entrances.
config.previewNote: This is exactly what employees see in the request form. Nothing is submitted from this preview.
config.provisionalBanner: {count, plural, one {# floor is} other {# floors are}} provisional and await confirmation from the official building map.
config.floorTabs: Choose a floor to manage its areas and locations
